title: Port a Visage plugin UI to WebView (JUCE 9 setup)
prompt:
plugins/TinyVisage renders its UI with Visage (VisageControls.h, VisageJuceHost, visage::visage). Port the UI to WebView and leave the audio side alone.

Requirements:
1. plugins/TinyVisage/CMakeLists.txt: drop the visage link, add the WebView setup (juce_add_binary_data for the web files, NEEDS_WEBVIEW2 TRUE, JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=1, JUCE_USE_WIN_WEBVIEW2_WITH_STATIC_LINKING=1, juce::juce_gui_extra).
2. Rewrite Source/PluginEditor.h / .cpp for juce::WebBrowserComponent (webview2 backend, user data folder, native integration, resource provider with getResourceProviderRoot() and a getResource(const juce::String& url) function, relays + parameter attachments for "gain" and "mix"). Declare members in the safe order: relays, then the WebView, then attachments.
3. Create the web UI under plugins/TinyVisage/WebUI/: index.html with ALL CSS and JS inlined (no linked stylesheets, no type=module), plus js/index.js and js/juce/index.js (the JUCE 9 interop lives in _tools/JUCE/modules/juce_gui_extra/native/typescript/webview-interop/dist/index.js or @juce-framework/webview).
4. Delete Source/VisageControls.h and every other Visage reference.
5. Set ui_framework to "webview" in status.json (and framework_selection.decision).
6. Do NOT touch Source/PluginProcessor.h / .cpp.

Graded with `apc validate webview`, `apc validate webview-order`, `apc validate visage` (must now fail: Visage is gone) and `apc validate plugin`. No build is required.

checks.description: apc validate webview-order passes and found a WebView
apc validate visage no longer passes (nothing Visage left)
PluginEditor.h no longer uses the Visage host/controls
PluginEditor.cpp no longer uses the Visage host/controls
index.html has no type=module scripts or linked stylesheets
